steps.note: Open the single-stage auction creation flow.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Create multiple line items so line-item-level bidding and ranking can be observed.

Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Place a buyer-entered bid so the auction has response data without requiring another login.
Open the live comparison grid where per-line bidding and ranks are displayed.
